Today, we'll resume charging for requests our safeguards block before Claude responds. This only applies in categories with low false positive rates: biology, distillation attacks, and frontier LLM development. We've seen some coordinated attacks on our systems in recent weeks, and this is one layer of defense. In recent testing, 99.7% of accounts using Claude Code, Claude​.ai, or Cowork did not hit any of these newly "billable blocks." The classifiers behind the blocks we’re resuming charging for today are tuned to have a <0.1% false positive rate. We know that's not 0%, and we're going to keep improving them so they interrupt your work less often. If you think a request has been blocked incorrectly, please report it with /feedback in Claude Code. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#how-refusals-are-billed

As our models grow more powerful, safeguards are one way we prevent misuse. Opus 5.5 is the first Opus with Fable 5.1-class safeguards on cyber, bio, and frontier LLM development. Flagged requests fall back to another model, and we're working to reduce incorrect flags.

Isso reduz o fluxo de sangue ao cérebro. Gatilhos comuns incluem dor intensa, medo, estresse emocional, visão de sangue ou ficar em pé por muito tempo. Geralmente é inofensiva e a pessoa recupera a consciência em segundos.

The CoMasonry image is a symbolic Masonic rendering: prominent twin pillars, sacred geometry, tools, and classical facade emphasizing order and harmony. It prioritizes emblematic meaning over strict historicity. The earlier night scenes I generated focus on the 2 Chronicles 7 theophany—glory as fire or light after dedication, with Solomon present. They capture the narrative well but use broader classical colonnades and scale common in AI art, rather than the biblical tripartite long-room form (ulam-heikal-debir, ~60x20x30 cubits) with freestanding bronze pillars (Jachin/Boaz) and side chambers attested in Near Eastern parallels like Ain Dara. No physical remains survive, so both are interpretive. The scholarly reconstructions stay closer to the Iron Age Levantine plan; the Masonic one heightens the pillars and geometry for Lodge symbolism.

No single person decided it all. The 7-day week traces to ancient Babylonians (celestial bodies) and Jews (Genesis creation story with Saturday as Sabbath). Early Christians shifted worship to Sunday for the Resurrection. In 321 AD, Emperor Constantine made Sunday an official rest day empire-wide. Week starting Monday is a modern convention, formalized in ISO 8601 (1988) to match the workweek. Traditional calendars often start on Sunday. Other days never stuck due to these long-standing religious and cultural habits.
